issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the appellants had an internal flight alternative in Merida or Campeche
issues.applicant_position: The RPD erred in assessing risk in the IFA cities and did not consider the documentary evidence on cartel reach.
issues.result_text: Documentary evidence shows the Jalisco cartel can locate the appellants in Merida or Campeche; the RPD erred.

issues.issue: Whether the cartel remains motivated to pursue the appellants despite the two-year gap
issues.applicant_position: The RPD erred in assessing the risk in the IFA cities, including the cartel's motivation.
issues.result_text: More likely than not the persecutors remain interested in pursuing the appellants who complained to police.

issues.issue: Whether adequate state protection is available to the appellants from the cartel
issues.result_text: Evidence rebuts the presumption of adequate state protection for cartel victims in Mexico.
